data.rationale: The proposal matches the true procedure (type destination, optionally pick dates, optionally open Filters and tick an amenity, click Find a KOA) with the same parameters. The only differences are that it names the filter parameter "ways_to_stay" instead of "filter" and treats dates as non-optional, and the spec is concrete enough to automate, though the calendar navigation and suggestion-pick details are a little loose.
